issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the phrase 'το προειρηκεναι' (that which was spoken before / what was foretold) at the end of the clause. The Greek indicates that the Holy Spirit bears witness *because* of what was foretold, but the Vietnamese ends the sentence abruptly after 'phán trước rằng' (foretold that), leaving the object of the foretelling/witnessing missing.
